'''2010 Canadian Nationals Imshan Poolar DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Imshan Poolar]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Old Dog
* '''Username:''' Ninth
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
